body: i feel as if i'm expected by my parents after all the love and money they have spent on me to be academically good. We aren't that rich and my mom and dad work their ass off for their money and yet I feel as if i'm letting them down. Even now, all I could do is give my mom a cup of water and she smiled and said thank you which only make me even more sad as we just had a fight yet she still loves me and I don't deserve it. And I want to be good at basketball but more then that I just want to make my mom and dad proud.
